Downtown Lincoln.name: Downtown Lincoln
Downtown Lincoln.description: Downtown Lincoln civic and office core with the Capitol, the Railyard entertainment district, and active mixed-use and adaptive-reuse permitting.

Haymarket.name: Haymarket
Haymarket.description: Historic Haymarket District with the Pinnacle Bank Arena adjacency, restaurant and retail build-outs, and strong commercial-to-residential conversion.

University of Nebraska.name: University of Nebraska
University of Nebraska.description: UNL campus corridor with University Place, student housing, institutional permitting, and the Innovation Campus redevelopment.

College View.name: College View
College View.description: College View neighborhood east of the campus with student-oriented housing, small commercial, and steady renovation permits.

South Lincoln.name: South Lincoln
South Lincoln.description: South Lincoln residential corridor with SouthPointe Mall retail, master-planned subdivisions, and the city's strongest new-home permit volume.

South 48th Street.name: South 48th Street
South 48th Street.description: Major south-north commercial corridor with auto dealerships, strip retail, and steady commercial tenant-improvement permitting.

South 70th Street.name: South 70th Street
South 70th Street.description: South 70th Street growth corridor with new subdivisions, big-box retail, and the Wilderness Hills development.

East Lincoln.name: East Lincoln
East Lincoln.description: East Lincoln residential corridor along 84th and 70th Streets with new subdivisions, schools, and small-strip commercial.

Havelock.name: Havelock
Havelock.description: Historic Havelock neighborhood in northeast Lincoln with older housing stock, small commercial, and the Havelock Main Street district.

West Lincoln.name: West Lincoln
West Lincoln.description: West Lincoln along Cornhusker Highway with industrial and warehouse permitting, auto-oriented commercial, and the airport adjacency.

North Lincoln.name: North Lincoln
North Lincoln.description: North Lincoln gateway corridor with the airpark, ag-industrial, and growing residential subdivision fringe.
